itemdesc-covalencedust-high: Used to build alchemical gear. 40 from 1 diamond + 1 coke.

itemdesc-trinket-soulstone: Heals you while on, for EMC.

itemdesc-gadget-archangelssmite: Fires homing arrows at hostile creatures; left-click for a volley.

itemdesc-redmattertool-katar: Sword, axe and shears in one. Tier 6; never wears out.

itemdesc-mattertool-red-shears: Cuts leaves at speed 18 and plants and cloth at 12. Tier 6; never wears out.

itemdesc-kleinstar-omega: Holds up to 51,200,000 EMC for your rings, amulets and gadgets.

Item + contents: worth the item plus its contents or material, and you learn and create exactly that version. clientcfg-icon: Show an icon while it's on
clientcfg-glow: Make the watch glow while it's on
clientcfg-note: Saved for this computer only (ModConfig/vintagee-client.json). Type .vintagee in chat to open this again.
setvalue-nowfree: Free ingredient: no value, free in recipes
setvalue-blacklist: Blacklisted: no value, can't be burned, learned or created
setvalue-gray: Gray list: no guessed value and left out of /emc missing, but valued by recipes
setvalue-free: Free ingredient: no value of its own, free in the recipes that use it
setvalue-fromfiles: (set by a value file or a wildcard: unticking here can't undo it)
setvalue-freefromfiles: It's a free ingredient in a value file, so it stays one.
setvalue-grayfromfiles: A value file or a wildcard puts it on the gray list, so it stays there.
dump-unknowncode: No block or item is called {0}. Try a full code like game:ingot-copper, or hold it and use /emc dump hand.
dumpgui-blacklisted: Blacklisted: it never has a value, and can't be burned, learned or created.
dumpgui-gray: On the gray list: only recipes give it a value (no guesses), and /emc missing leaves it out.
dumpgui-known: You know it: you can create it in the transmutation table.
dumpgui-unknown: You don't know it yet: burn one in the transmutation table to learn it.
dumpgui-sec-held: What this one is worth, step by step
dumpgui-sec-new: What a new one is worth, step by step
dumpgui-newnote: A new, unworn, empty one. A worn or filled one is worth more or less: hold it and use /emc dump hand, or press Ctrl+K over it and Why this value?
dumpgui-base: The plain item's value: {0} EMC (where it comes from is further down)
dumpgui-stored: + {0} EMC stored in it (a Klein star is worth what it holds) = {1}
dumpgui-data-contents: It holds things. Mode: {0} ({1}; change it with /emc contents).
dumpgui-data-material: What it's made of is stored on the item. Mode: {0} ({1}; change it with /emc contents).
dumpgui-data-chiseled: A chiseled block, made of voxels of other blocks. Mode: {0} ({1}; change it with /emc contents).
dumpgui-mode-item: Item only: what it holds or is made of doesn't count. It burns, and is created, as the plain item.
dumpgui-wouldcontents: (What it holds would be worth {0} EMC.)
dumpgui-protected: Something is inside, so the table and condensers won't burn it (ProtectContainersWithContents).
dumpgui-mode-itemprice: Item price only: what it holds ({0} EMC) is free; it doesn't count when burning or creating it.
dumpgui-nomaterialvalue: What it's made of has no value, so this one has none.
dumpgui-molten: + {0} units of molten {1} (100 units = one, at {2} EMC) = {3}
dumpgui-servings: x {0} servings (a meal keeps one serving's ingredients) = {1} EMC for what's inside
dumpgui-variant: This version ({0}) has its own value: {1} EMC
dumpgui-novariant: Nothing the mod knows makes this exact version, so it's worth the plain item: {0} EMC
dumpgui-variants: {0} versions of it have their own values, from {1} to {2} EMC.
dumpgui-novoxels: No voxels stored on it, so it has no value.
dumpgui-voxels: + {0}: {1} of 4096 voxels, at {2} EMC a block = {3}
dumpgui-voxels-novalue: {0}: {1} voxels, but it has no value, so the whole block has none
dumpgui-wear-off: Durability {0}/{1} doesn't change the value: DurabilityScalesEmc is off in the server config.
dumpgui-wear-full: Durability {0}/{0}: as good as new, so nothing comes off (a worn one is worth less: DurabilityScalesEmc).
dumpgui-wear-contents: Only the item wears: what's inside keeps its full value.
dumpgui-liquid: A liquid: {0} portions make a litre, so a litre is worth {1} EMC.
dumpgui-fresh: How fresh it is doesn't count: once it spoils it turns into something else (rot), with its own value.
dumpgui-result: = {0} EMC each: what burning one gives, and what creating one costs
dumpgui-resultnone: = no value: it can't be burned, learned or created
dumpgui-sec-origin: Where the plain item's value comes from
dumpgui-free-config: A free ingredient, from the server config's FreeIngredients ("{0}"): no value of its own, and the recipes that use it don't pay for it.
dumpgui-free-file: A free ingredient, from a value file ("{0}"): no value of its own, and the recipes that use it don't pay for it.
dumpgui-bl-zero: Set to 0 by hand ("{0}" in the server config), which takes its value away.
dumpgui-bl-config: On the server config's Blacklist ("{0}"). Ctrl+K over it, or the /emc blacklist window, takes it off.
dumpgui-bl-attribute: Its own mod says it has no EMC ("emcValue": 0 in its attributes).
dumpgui-bl-file: Blacklisted by a value file ("{0}"). The /emc blacklist window can make an exception.
dumpgui-base-fixed: Set by hand: FixedValues "{0}" = {1} in the server config (from /emc set, Ctrl+K or /emc configure).
dumpgui-base-wildcard: That's a wildcard: Ctrl+K over this item sets just this one.
dumpgui-base-attribute: Its own mod gives it this value ("emcValue": {0} in its attributes).
dumpgui-base-litre: A value file ({0}): "{1}" = {2} a litre; {3} portions make a litre, so one is worth {4}.
dumpgui-base-note: A base value: the mapper starts from it, and everything made from it builds on it.
dumpgui-base-fixednote: Recipes never change a value set by hand. Unpin it (Ctrl+K, Unpin) to let recipes decide again.
dumpgui-guessnote: A guess, used only because no recipe gives it a value. If it's off, give it a real one with Ctrl+K or BaseValues.
dumpgui-made: Made by {0} (the cheapest way the mapper found):
dumpgui-term-free: {0} x{1}: a free ingredient, costs nothing
dumpgui-timebonus: {0} for the time it takes: {1} in-game days to {2}, at {3} EMC a day (TransitionEmcPerDay)
dumpgui-back: Worked backwards ({1}): nothing the mapper knows makes it, but {0} uses it, so it's worth what that makes minus everything else that goes in:
dumpgui-joint-back: Worked backwards: {0} turns it into several things at once, so it's worth all of them together:
dumpgui-joint: Shared out: {0} makes several things at once; what isn't already valued gets an even share of what goes in:
dumpgui-share: = {0} left, split evenly between the {1} things that had no value: {2} each; {3} of this make one share, so {4} EMC each
dumpgui-frozen: Recipe loop: its recipes kept making each other cheaper, so it kept the first value it got.
dumpgui-differs: (It keeps {0} EMC: the values above changed after it was worked out.)
dumpgui-other-note: The cheapest way sets the value, so nothing can be made for less than it burns for.
dumpgui-other-set: Its value is set, so these don't change it.
dumpgui-way-lacks: {0}: can't be priced, no value for {1}
dumpgui-loop: Stuck in a value loop: {0}. Each is only made from the next, and nothing outside the loop gives any of them a value.
dumpgui-fixhint: To give it a value: Ctrl+K over it (or Set value below), a recipe in /emc recipe, or a value for a missing ingredient.
loopgui-remapped: The values came from the cache, which doesn't keep recipes, so they were worked out again to find the loops.
loopgui-header: {0} value loop(s): in each, every item is only made from the next one, so none of them can get a value.
loopgui-help: Give any one item in a loop a value (Ctrl+K over it, or click it and Set value) and the rest follow. Click an item to see why it has none.
loopgui-settledhelp: Recipes that kept making each other cheaper; their items kept the first value they got. If one looks too cheap, set it with Ctrl+K.
reportgui-searchloops: Find an item in the loops...
dumpgui-code: Code: {0} (as the server config and value files write it)
dumpgui-nofactors: Nothing about one in particular changes that: it has no durability, contents or stored EMC.
dumpgui-perback: = {0} for the {1} it takes, so {2} EMC each
dumpgui-short-config: a base value in the server config (BaseValues)
dumpgui-short-attribute: a base value its own mod gives it
dumpgui-src-placement-state: placing it (the same block facing or standing another way)
table-noowner: Nobody owns this table yet: the next person to open it does. A hopper or chute pointing into it feeds it items to burn into its owner's EMC.
table-owner: A hopper or chute pointing into it burns items into {0}'s EMC.
table-owner-you: A hopper or chute pointing into it burns items into your EMC.
dumpgui-cond-off: Condition {0} doesn't change the value: DurabilityScalesEmc is off in the server config.
dumpgui-cond-full: Condition 100%: as good as new, so nothing comes off (worn clothes are worth less: DurabilityScalesEmc).
dumpgui-burnwith: Burning this one gives {0} EMC: ProtectContainersWithContents is off, so what's inside counts too.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:phil:
Right-click a block to transmute it into its neighbour in a chain (stone types, wood types, sand ↔ gravel, ...); sneak + right-click goes the other way.
Tool-mode key: 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 at once. Free, and never used up when crafting with it.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:tran: A transmutation table you carry: right-click to open it anywhere. Burn items into EMC to learn them, then create anything you know from your EMC.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:alch: Burns at 1,500 °C for 640 seconds. In a forge it lasts 16x as long and burns 400 °C hotter. Made from 4 alchemical coal.
Burns at 1,600 °C for 2,560 seconds. In a forge it lasts 64x as long and burns 600 °C hotter. Made from 4 mobius fuel; the base of dark matter.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:matt: Condensed EMC: 8 aeternalis fuel around a temporal gear. Tier 5 tools and armour made from it never wear out. 4 make a dark matter block.
Denser still: 3 dark matter between 6 aeternalis fuel. Tier 6 tools and armour that never wear out. 4 make a red matter block.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:trin:
While on: pulls loose items within 7 blocks to you. Free.
Right-click a water or lava source to remove it.
On a pedestal: pulls in items within 10 blocks and puts them into containers next to the pedestal.
Works from your hotbar or backpack; right-click to switch on/off.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

While on: you can fly (jump to rise, sneak to sink) and/or a shield pushes hostile creatures and arrows away within 8 blocks; pick flight + shield, flight or shield with the tool-mode key.
The tool-mode key also picks your speed, running and flying: 1x, 1.5x, 2x or 3x (only with flight on; shield only leaves your speed alone).
Flying costs 6.4 EMC a second x your speed while you are in the air; running faster than normal costs 6.4 EMC a second x (speed - 1) while you move; the shield costs 6.4 EMC a second. No fall damage while it's on and for 15 seconds after you stop flying. It switches off when you run out of EMC.
On a pedestal: strikes hostile creatures within 10 blocks for 4 damage a second.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

While on: crops within 5 blocks grow (6 tries a second, 4 EMC per stage) and ripe ones are harvested. Switched off it still grows nearby crops slowly, for free.
Right-click farmland to plant the seeds you carry on empty farmland up to 8 blocks around.
On a pedestal: grows and harvests crops within 8 blocks.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

Carry it (on or off) and fire can't hurt you.
While on: hostile creatures within 5 blocks catch fire and take 3 damage, 4 EMC each, once a second.
Fire-projectile key: shoots a fireball (3 damage and sets the creature alight; it also lights what it hits, as a torch would, and sets wood and other things that burn on fire). Free.
On a pedestal: burns hostile creatures within 8 blocks.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

While on: still water within 3 blocks of you freezes into ice. Free.
On a pedestal: freezes water within 6 blocks and puts out burning creatures.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

The Zero Ring, Ignition Ring, Harvest Goddess Band and Swiftwolf's Rending Gale in one, and all free.
The tool-mode key switches each of the four on or off (all on to start). Fire can't hurt you while you carry it.
Fire-projectile key: shoots a fireball while its Ignition effect is on.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

While on: when you are 100 saturation or more below full, it feeds you up to 200 saturation for 0.5 EMC each (every 2 seconds).
Tool-mode key: saturation only, or saturation and nutrition (1 EMC each), which also fills your food groups, the emptiest first.
On a pedestal: feeds players within 6 blocks 25 saturation a second, free (with nutrition too in that mode).

While on: heals you 1 health a second for 64 EMC each.
On a pedestal: heals players within 6 blocks 0.5 health a second, free.

Body Stone and Soul Stone in one: feeds you (0.5 EMC per saturation) and heals you (64 EMC per health) while on.
Tool-mode key: saturation only, or saturation and nutrition (1 EMC per saturation), which also fills your food groups.
On a pedestal: feeds and heals players within 6 blocks, free.

Always works while you carry it: repairs 1 durability a second on every damaged tool, weapon and piece of armour you carry or wear, and restores clothing condition (1% a minute by default; the server can change or turn that off). Free.
On a pedestal: does the same for players within 6 blocks.

While on: every 2 seconds it eats cheap junk you carry (anything worth 8 EMC or less: stone, soil, sand, gravel, sticks...) and turns it into the target.
Targets (tool-mode key): iron ingot, gold ingot, diamond, dark matter, red matter. Leftover EMC is kept for next time.

Gem of Eternal Density and Black Hole Band in one: while on it pulls in items within 7 blocks and condenses junk worth 8 EMC or less into the target (tool-mode key).
Sneak + right-click: teleport to the block you look at, up to 64 blocks away. Free, twice a second at most.
Right-click a water or lava source to remove it.
Can be worn in your hand slot, where it keeps working.

Right-click a block to place a water source next to it. Free.
Fire-projectile key: shoots a ball of water that leaves a water source where it lands.
On a pedestal: makes it rain until you take it off.

Right-click a block to place a lava source next to it, 32 EMC each.
Fire-projectile key: shoots a ball of lava (32 EMC) that leaves a lava source where it lands.
Carry it and fire can't hurt you. On a pedestal: clears the sky until you take it off.

While on: time runs 10x faster for the whole world (crops, cooking, curing, drying, day and night) for 8 EMC a second, and crops within 6 blocks get extra growth.
Tool-mode key: slow time to a third instead (4 EMC a second), which also slows hostile creatures within 10 blocks.
On a pedestal: grows crops within 12 blocks and slows hostile creatures, free.
While it's on, an icon on screen shows how fast time runs and the watch glows; type .vintagee in chat to move, resize, recolour or turn these off.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:gadg: Right-click a block to break a 3x3 tunnel into it: 1, 4, 8 or 16 blocks deep (charge 0-3, tool-mode key). 8 EMC per block broken; everything drops where you clicked.

Right-click (or the fire-projectile key) to shoot an explosive charge. It flies straight at 36 blocks a second and explodes where it hits.
Charge (tool-mode key): radius 4, 6, 8 or 10 for 384, 768, 1,536 or 2,304 EMC.

Right-click a block to break a 3x3 tunnel 1, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 or 64 blocks deep (charge 0-7, tool-mode key), 8 EMC per block.
Fire-projectile key: shoots the Hyperkinetic Lens's explosive charge (charge 3 and up: radius 10, 2,304 EMC).

Sneak + right-click a block to remember it, then right-click blocks to turn them into it: 1x1, or 3x3, 5x5, 7x7 or 9x9 of the same block as the one clicked (tool-mode key).
You pay the difference in EMC, and get it back when the old block was worth more.

Right-click: fires a homing arrow that steers towards hostile creatures (3 damage). Left-click: a volley of 10.
Each arrow costs what an arrow is worth in EMC.
Creative mode only. Right-click to learn every block and item in the creative inventory that can be transmuted. Not used up, and it can't be crafted or made from EMC.
Right-click a block: reports the total and average EMC of the 3x3 column below it, 16 blocks deep, and the most valuable block found. Lasts as many uses as 10x its EMC value.
Right-click a block: reports the total and average EMC of the 3x3 column below it, 32 blocks deep, and the most valuable block found. Lasts as many uses as 10x its EMC value.
Right-click a block: reports the total and average EMC of the 3x3 column below it, 128 blocks deep, and the most valuable block found. Lasts as many uses as 10x its EMC value.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:redm: Sword, axe and shears in one: 14 attack (a steel falx does 5.25), reach 3 blocks; chops wood at speed 16 and fells whole trees; cuts plants and leaves at 14, 3x3 or 5x5 with the tool-mode key. Tier 6; never wears out.

Pickaxe, shovel and sledgehammer in one: digs stone, ore, metal, soil, sand and gravel at speed 14, 3x3 at a time (5x5 or one block with the tool-mode key; sneak for one block). 10 attack, tier 6; never wears out.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:klei:
Holds up to 50,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.

Holds up to 200,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.

Holds up to 800,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.

Holds up to 3,200,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.

Holds up to 12,800,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.

Holds up to 51,200,000 EMC. Rings, amulets and gadgets draw from the stars you carry once your own EMC runs out.
Right-click: empty it into your EMC. Sneak + right-click: fill it from your EMC. Sneak + right-click a collector or relay with it to charge it.
Four stars craft into the next size and keep their EMC. Can be worn in your emblem slot.
vintagee:item-handbooktext-vintagee:matt: Digs stone, ore and metal at speed 9. Tool-mode key: 3x3 at once (sneak for one block). 3.5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
Digs soil, sand, gravel and snow at speed 9. Tool-mode key: 3x3 at once (sneak for one block). 3.5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
Chops wood at speed 9 and fells whole trees. Tool-mode key: 3x3 at once (sneak for one block). 5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
Sledgehammer: smashes stone, ore and other hard blocks at speed 8, 3x3 at a time; sneak or the tool-mode key for one block. 5 attack. Tier 5; never wears out.
Digs stone, ore and metal at speed 14. Tool-mode key: 3x3 or 5x5 at once (sneak for one block). 4.5 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
Digs soil, sand, gravel and snow at speed 14. Tool-mode key: 3x3 or 5x5 at once (sneak for one block). 4.5 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
Chops wood at speed 14 and fells whole trees. Tool-mode key: 3x3 or 5x5 at once (sneak for one block). 7 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.
Sledgehammer: smashes stone, ore and other hard blocks at speed 12, 3x3 at a time (5x5 with the tool-mode key); sneak or the tool-mode key for one block. 7 attack. Tier 6; never wears out.

99% protection, 3.6 flat damage reduction, protection tier 7, +6% walk speed and +15% healing per piece. A full set (helmet, chestplate, leggings) makes you immune to fall and fire damage. Never wears out.

99% protection, 3.6 flat damage reduction, protection tier 7, +6% walk speed and +15% healing per piece. A full set (helmet, chestplate, leggings) makes you immune to fall and fire damage. Never wears out.

99% protection, 3.6 flat damage reduction, protection tier 7, +6% walk speed and +15% healing per piece. A full set (helmet, chestplate, leggings) makes you immune to fall and fire damage. Never wears out.
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:tra: Right-click to open. Burn items into EMC to learn them (or drop them on Learn to learn them and keep them), then create anything you know from your EMC. The window closes if you walk more than 10 blocks away. A hopper or chute pointing into the table feeds it items, which it burns into its owner's EMC (whoever placed it) a few at a time while they're online.
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:ene:
Makes up to 4 EMC a second in full sunlight (less in shade, none in the dark) and stores 10,000.
Feeds condensers, furnaces and relays next to it every second; sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.

Makes up to 12 EMC a second in full sunlight (less in shade, none in the dark) and stores 30,000.
Feeds condensers, furnaces and relays next to it every second; sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.

Makes up to 40 EMC a second in full sunlight (less in shade, none in the dark) and stores 60,000.
Feeds condensers, furnaces and relays next to it every second; sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.

Put an item in the target slot: it burns up to 4 other items a second (plus EMC from collectors) and makes up to 1 copy of the target a second.
Stores up to 1,000,000 EMC; 40 storage slots.

Put an item in the target slot: it burns up to 16 other items a second (plus EMC from collectors) and makes up to 4 copies of the target a second.
Stores up to 10,000,000 EMC; 40 storage slots.
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:ant:
Stores up to 100,000 EMC from collectors, adds 1 EMC a second while it holds any, and passes up to 64 EMC a second on to condensers, furnaces and emptier relays.
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.

Stores up to 1,000,000 EMC from collectors, adds 3 EMC a second while it holds any, and passes up to 192 EMC a second on to condensers, furnaces and emptier relays.
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.

Stores up to 10,000,000 EMC from collectors, adds 10 EMC a second while it holds any, and passes up to 640 EMC a second on to condensers, furnaces and emptier relays.
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand (or a Klein star) to take the EMC yourself.
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:nov: Light it like the game's bombs: hold right-click on it with a torch or a firestarter. It explodes 4 seconds later with a radius of 6 blocks, and everything it breaks drops.
Light it like the game's bombs: hold right-click on it with a torch or a firestarter. It explodes 6 seconds later with a radius of 11 blocks, and everything it breaks drops.
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:int: Pushes hostile creatures out of an 8-block radius, 4 times a second. Gives off light level 20 (a torch gives 14). Needs no fuel.
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:ped: Right-click with a ring, stone, amulet, talisman or watch to set it here: it then works on the area around the pedestal for free (see each item's description for what it does on a pedestal, usually 6-12 blocks).
vintagee:block-handbooktext-vintagee:fur:
Works like the game's firepit (same window, fuel slot, cooking pots, crucibles and spits; light it with a firestarter or torch), but made of dark matter:
fuel burns 1.4x hotter and lasts 3x as long, and food, clay and metal cook or melt 4x faster once hot.
Collectors and relays next to it can power it instead: with nothing burning it lights itself on EMC, 2 EMC a second at 1,819 °C.
